independent_computation.method: The scenario's roster spec is not inside the permitted evidence tree (it lives in scripts/ or tests/, which this runbook forbids reading). So the leaf was audited structurally: the observed old->new delta was factored against the only two damage-amplification constants the cached wiki text licenses for this build (Unmake 12% magic, Command 7% all), and each candidate factorization was checked for consistency with the *scope* clauses in that same text.

command_7pct_alone.conclusion: REJECTED. Removing Command's 7% Vulnerable can move a total by at most a factor 1.07 (ratio 1.0700), and the observed ratio is 1.0819 > 1.07. Neither 3269.6/1.07 nor 3022.0*1.07 lands on the other value. Command's factor is therefore ABSENT FROM BOTH values - i.e. the engine already withholds the Vulnerable mark in this leaf, which is exactly what S3/S4 require: the mark is only placed by 'immobilizing an ENEMY CHAMPION', and an epic-monster objective cannot be marked.

unmake_12pct_on_the_whole_total.conclusion: REJECTED as a whole-total factor (ratio would be 1.1200, not 1.0819). The amp therefore acted on a SUB-total, which is what a type-scoped amp does.

unmake_12pct_on_the_magic_sub_total.conclusion: ACCEPTED as the unique clean factorization. The old value = new value with one 12% multiplier applied to a 2063.33 magic sub-total; the new value = that same sub-total un-amplified. Note 247.6/0.12 = 2063.3333... falls out as an exact repeating third, whereas the competing factorization that would keep a 1.07 Command factor in play (delta = 0.12*1.07*M => M = 1928.3489) is arithmetically ragged and is independently excluded by step_2.command_7pct_alone.

step_3_scope_ruling.rule_quoted: S1/S2: the curse lands on 'Enemy CHAMPIONS within 700 units of you'; only cursed units 'receive 12% increased MAGIC damage from all sources'.
step_3_scope_ruling.leaf_context: The leaf sits under .../combat/objective/main_team_damage_before_death - the main team's cumulative damage, before death, in the OBJECTIVE fight. The damage recipient in that block is an epic-monster objective, not an enemy champion.
step_3_scope_ruling.ruling: Unmake's 12% amplifier cannot apply. An epic monster is not an enemy champion, so it never becomes cursed and never receives the 12% magic increase. The old value carries exactly one such 12% multiplier on the magic sub-total (2063.33 -> 2310.93); the new value carries none.
step_3_scope_ruling.corroboration: The SAME champion-only restriction is what already suppresses Imperial Mandate's Command in both values (step_2). It would be internally inconsistent for the engine to honour 'immobilizing an enemy champion' as champion-gated while treating 'enemy champions within 700 units of you become cursed' as target-agnostic. The new value makes the two champion-only clauses agree; the old value did not.
step_3_scope_ruling.fail_closed_note: Even under the weaker reading in which the objective block's damage recipient could be a champion, the curse still requires a 700-unit proximity condition that the deterministic model does not establish. Per the project's own withholding convention for unestablished sources, un-amplified (the new value) is the fail-closed answer; amplified is the assumption.

independent_computation.independent_value_derivation: team damage before death = non-magic sub-total + magic sub-total, with NO Unmake curse multiplier and NO Command Vulnerable multiplier, since the objective target is neither cursable nor markable: 958.6667 + 2063.3333 = 3022.0. The old value 3269.6 = 958.6667 + 2063.3333*1.12 over-applies Unmake by 247.6 (7.573% of the reported total).

residual_uncertainty: The roster composition, levels, and target stats for 'mandate_abyssal_curse_roster' are not present anywhere under data/, so the two sub-totals (2063.33 magic / 958.67 non-magic) were solved FROM the reported pair rather than simulated forward. The verdict therefore rests on (a) the exact 1.12 factorization of the delta and (b) the scope clauses quoted above, not on an end-to-end re-simulation.

If a future reviewer establishes that this leaf's damage recipient is an enemy champion standing inside the 700-unit curse radius, the ruling inverts and 3269.6 becomes correct. Nothing in data/ or docs/math-foundations.md supports that reading of a leaf keyed 'objective'.
verdict_rationale: The cached wiki text scopes Abyssal Mask's Unmake to cursed ENEMY CHAMPIONS and to MAGIC damage only. The old value contains exactly one 12% magic-only multiplier applied against an objective target that can be neither cursed nor (per Imperial Mandate's identically champion-gated Command, already absent from both values) marked Vulnerable. Removing it yields 3022.0. New value correct.
